hints.title: Generating Uniform Random Permutations
hints.text: Every permutation of the array must have equal probability of one over factorial N of being returned.

hints.title: Fisher-Yates In-Place Shuffle
hints.text: Iterate backwards from index n - 1 down to 1. For each position i, choose a uniform random index j between 0 and i inclusive and swap elements.

hints.title: Reset and Shuffle Operations Blueprint
hints.text: Retain an immutable clone of original input in self.original. reset() returns self.original. shuffle() creates a copy and performs in-place Fisher-Yates swaps using random.randint(0, i).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Fisher-Yates linear shuffle guaranteeing uniform probability distribution.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting with random comparisons produces non-uniform permutations and violates the 1/N! equality requirement.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing the original configuration preserves initial state for O(N) copy restoration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct index bounds: random index j must be drawn from [0, i], not [0, n - 1].

solutions.approach: Fisher-Yates Linear Shuffle with Original State Retention
